# Reminder: legacy API gateway shutting down

_Category: Announcements · Source: BC Registries API community forum_

**Sandra** (5/26/2025):

As previously communicated, we are retiring our legacy API gateway and updating the DNS for endpoints. URLs referencing `apigee.net` will cease to be supported at the end of this month.

All API users should have updated their applications to the new **api.connect.gov.bc.ca** DNS.

See our [developer site](https://developer.connect.gov.bc.ca/en-CA/products/get-started/apis-summary#api-common-information) for more information.
